column1: # Real RGI 7.0 glacier outlines from RGI2000-v7.0-G-06_iceland, for the
# offline burn tests in test/test_rgi7_modis_cells.jl. Z dropped (the
# shipped shapefile is PolygonZ); geometry otherwise verbatim.
# 06-00241: 14 rings, i.e. 13 nunataks. Burns 147 cells; filling the holes
#           gives 154, so this pins interior-ring exclusion on real data.
# 06-00147: 0.0443 km2, smaller than one 0.21464 km2 cell, so it has no
#           interior cell at all and exercises the forced-cell rule.
